messages.content: 有史以來最高票房的電影是什麼？

function.name: movies_search
function.description: Search movies based on a set of specified criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: The release year of the movie.

genre.description: The genre of the movie. Default: 'science fiction'

message.content:
截至目前（2023 年底），全球票房最高的電影是 **《阿凡達》（Avatar，2009）**。根據 Box Office Mojo 等統計數據，該片在全球累計票房約為 **29 億美元**（約 290 億人民幣左右），超過了此前的冠軍《復仇者聯盟：終局之戰》（Avengers: Endgame，2019）的 27 億美元。

> **備註**  
> - 若按通貨膨脹調整後的實際購買力，排名可能會有所變動；例如《亂世佳人》在調整後往往能排到前列。  
> - 以上數字僅包含公開上映期間的票房收入，不包括後續的 DVD、藍光、串流平台等額外收益。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "有史以來最高票房的電影是什麼？" which means "What is the highest-grossing movie of all time?" They want the highest grossing film worldwide. That would be "Avatar" (2009) or "Avengers: Endgame"? As of 2023, "Avatar" remains the highest worldwide grossing film at about $2.92 billion. But we need to confirm with the function? The function is movies_search, but it only searches movies based on title, year, and optional genre. It doesn't provide a way to search for highest grossing. So we cannot use the function. We can answer directly. The user didn't ask for a specific year or genre. So we can answer: "截至目前（2023年），《阿凡達》（2009）是全球票房最高的電影，總票房約29億美元。" Or mention that "Avengers: Endgame" was second. Provide context. Also note that inflation adjustments might change ranking. But the question likely expects "Avatar". So answer accordingly.
